units.title: Actual normalized PBPS endpoint-pair sector reversal

sources.label: Appendix A.1 fixed-count change of variables and initial Eq3.1 Gibbs averaging; actual normalized endpoint-pair sector measure reversal.
sources.scope: Actual normalized fixed-count endpoint-pair measure reversal only. Countable assembly, signed bilinear identity, process invariance, Markovness, hypocoercivity, implementation error, actual expected costs and all full paper/composition results remain open.

assumptions: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E with canonical volume, including dimension zero.
alpha,beta>=0; alpha>0; alpha<=beta; V is C2; alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v; eta>0; beta*eta<=1.
Every y,r in E, n>=0 and finite nonnegative T. Literal harmonic flow, totalized reflection, nonnegative event rate, strict time simplex, actual recursively reflected states and interpolated endpoint.

The actual density is the product of event rates and interval survivals times terminal survival. Initial phase measure is tilted conditional position law times standard Gaussian momentum; no extra normalizer, integrability, measurability, sigma-finiteness or finite-sector-mass hypothesis.
units.statement:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel sigma algebra; zero dimension is allowed. Let alpha,beta>=0, eta be real, V:E->R. Assume exactly alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. All conclusions hold for every y,r in E, initial phase z0=(x0,p0), integer n>=0 and finite T>=0.
Set c=y-eta*grad V(r). For z=(x,p), define Phi_u(z)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p). Define h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p-[2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2]h_r(x)) with real division totalized by 0/0=0, lambda_r(x,p)=sqrt(eta)max(0,<p,h_r(x)>), and Lambda_z(u)=integral from0 to u of lambda_r(Phi_s(z)) ds for u>=0, using Lebesgue measure.
A tagged record is either live(a,z), with a>=0, or stopped; Hist_n is the type of all n+1 records. Let Delta_n(T) be the strict simplex 0<t1<...<tn<T. Write a0=0, ai=ti (1<=i<=n), a_(n+1)=T. Given t in Delta_n(T), define z_i=S_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))) for1<=i<=n and K_n(t)_j=live(a_j,z_j). The literal Lean nonnegative conversions preserve these nonnegative times. Define qReal_n(t)=product_(i=1)^n [lambda_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))) exp(-Lambda_(z_(i-1))(a_i-a_(i-1)))], q_n=ofReal(qReal_n).
For arbitrary histories let readTime(live(a,z))=a and readTime(stopped)=0; d_n(T,h)=max(T-readTime(h_n),0). Put W(live(a,z),u)=ofReal(exp(-Lambda_z(u))) and W(stopped,u)=0. Define rho_n(T,t)=q_n(t) W(K_n(t)_n,d_n(T,K_n(t))). Here ofReal(x) is max(x,0) embedded into extended nonnegative reals; no probability law or normalization is assumed in this deterministic identity.
Define Path_T as all phase-valued functions on[0,T]. The total interpolation Psi_n(h)(s) starts at z0 and scans records j=0,...,n in order: a live(a,z) record with a<=s replaces the accumulator by Phi_(max(s-a,0))(z); otherwise it is unchanged. Set Gamma_n(t)=Psi_n(K_n(t)).
Define R(x,p)=(x,-p), Vy(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), and pi_y=volume_E.tilted(-Vy), that is, the measure with density ofReal(exp(-Vy(x))/integral exp(-Vy) dx). Let gamma=stdGaussian(E), the centered identity-covariance Gaussian. Let m_n,T be the comap of Lebesgue measure on R^n by the inclusion of the strict simplex Prefix_n(T), without a factorial factor or an extra normalization.
For every y,r in E, n>=0 and T>=0, let X_n,T=(E times E) times Prefix_n(T), with phase coordinate first. Define the actual terminal phase A(z,t)=Gamma_(y,r,z,n,T,t)(T), endpoint-pair map B(z,t)=(z,A(z,t)), and the density-weighted sector measure sigma_(y,r,n,T)=((pi_y times gamma) times m_n,T).withDensity((z,t) -> rho_(y,r,z,n,T)(t)). This uses precisely the actual product of event rates, intervening survivals and terminal survival defined above. Define its pushforward L_(y,r,n,T)=map B sigma_(y,r,n,T), a measure on (E times E) times (E times E). Define J(z0,zT)=(R(zT),R(z0)).
Then J is measurable and map J L_(y,r,n,T)=L_(y,r,n,T) for every y,r,n,T. Equivalently J is measure preserving from this actual endpoint-pair measure to itself. Phase normalization, joint measurability, simplex sigma-finiteness and the density conversion are established internally; none is a supplied premise. The word normalized describes the initial phase probability pi_y times gamma; it does not assert that each fixed-count sector has total mass one. The statement does not supply a finite-mass or subprobability bound for sigma or L. The result includes n=0, T=0, dimension-zero E, zero reflection normals and zero rates. For n>0,T=0 the strict simplex is empty. Countable sector assembly, signed bilinear identities, process invariance, restart/Markovness, hypocoercivity, implementation error, expected costs and whole-paper/composition conclusions remain separate.

steps.title: Align the two event-time reversal witnesses
steps.text: In this step only, use zero-based Fin n coordinates i=0,...,n-1; the earlier strict-simplex description uses one-based coordinates. The endpoint reversal and nonnegative weighted substitution each provide a time reversal with the same coordinate formula. Subtype and coordinate extensionality identify them, so one map serves both parents.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨rhoTime, hrho, h97⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualEndpointTimeReversal.actual_endpoint_time_reversal_laws
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη n T
  obtain ⟨rho102, hrho102, h102⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualWeightedSector.actual_weighted_sector_lintegral
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη n T
  have halign : rho102 = rhoTime := by
    funext t
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    exact (hrho102 t i).trans (hrho t i).symm
  subst rho102

steps.title: Construct the measurable endpoint diagram
steps.text: Fix y,r using a measurable embedding into the joint parameter domain. The actual terminal map is measurable. Pair it with the initial phase to obtain B; momentum reversal gives measurable J and Theta. The parent endpoint reversal proves B after Theta equals J after B, including the final flow arc.
steps.lean:
rcases h97 with ⟨hTimeM, hTimeI, hTimeP, hAformula, hAjoint, hAvolume,
    hArev, hThetajoint, hThetaI, hThetaP⟩
  let Theta : (E × E) × Prefix n T → (E × E) × Prefix n T :=
    fun q => (R (A q), rhoTime q.2)
  have hemb : Measurable (fun q : (E × E) × Prefix n T => (((y, r), q.1), q.2)) :=
    (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
  have hA : Measurable A := hAjoint.comp hemb
  have hB : Measurable B := measurable_fst.prodMk hA
  have hR : Measurable R := measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_snd.neg
  have hJ : Measurable J := (hR.comp measurable_snd).prodMk (hR.comp measurable_fst)
  have hTheta : Measurable Theta := hThetajoint.comp hemb
  have hinter (x : (E × E) × Prefix n T) : B (Theta x) = J (B x) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact hArev y r x.1 x.2

steps.title: Recover joint measurability of the actual density
steps.text: Apply the finite-count path theorem at the same original analytic assumptions and compose its joint density map with the fixed-parameter embedding. This is the actual rho, including terminal survival.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualFiniteCountPath.actual_finite_count_path_law
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hρjoint : Measurable (fun p : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × Prefix n T =>
      ρ p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2 p.1.2 n T p.2) := (hZ.2.2.2.2 n T).2.2.1
  have hρ := hρjoint.comp hemb
  have hρliteral : Measurable (fun x : (E × E) × Prefix n T => ρ y r x.1 n T x.2) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hρ

steps.title: Justify the simplex measure product
steps.text: Each coordinate inequality is measurable. Express the strict time ordering and terminal bound as finite, hence countable, intersections. Mapping the subtype measure back to Euclidean time space gives restricted Lebesgue measure; sigma-finiteness pulls back along the measurable inclusion.
steps.lean:
have hcons (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      Measurable (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i) := by
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact measurable_const
    | succ i => exact measurable_pi_apply i
  have hs : MeasurableSet (Δ n T) := by
    change MeasurableSet {t : Fin n → ℝ |
      (∀ i j : Fin (n + 1), i < j → (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i < (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n, t i < (T : ℝ)}
    rw [Set.ofPred_and]
    apply MeasurableSet.inter
    · simpa only [← Set.ofPred_forall] using (MeasurableSet.iInter fun (i : Fin (n + 1)) =>
        MeasurableSet.iInter fun (j : Fin (n + 1)) =>
        MeasurableSet.iInter fun (_ : i < j) => measurableSet_lt (hcons i) (hcons j))
    · simpa only [← Set.ofPred_forall] using (MeasurableSet.iInter fun (i : Fin n) =>
        measurableSet_lt (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_const (a := (T : ℝ))))
  have hmσ : SigmaFinite ((m n T).map (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val)) := by
    change SigmaFinite ((Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val)
      (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))).map (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val))
    rw [map_comap_subtype_coe hs]
    infer_instance
  letI : SigmaFinite (m n T) := SigmaFinite.of_map (m n T) measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable hmσ
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Identify the normalized phase density
steps.text: C2 regularity makes the phase Gibbs weight measurable. The existing phase normalization theorem proves that its reciprocal-partition density on phase volume is exactly pi_y times the standard Gaussian. Its positivity and finiteness are supplied by that theorem, not by extra binders here.
steps.lean:
let U : E × E → ℝ := fun z => V z.1 + ‖z.1 - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) + ‖z.2‖ ^ 2 / 2
  let w : E × E → ℝ := fun z => Real.exp (-U z)
  let ell : Measure (E × E) := (volume : Measure E).prod (volume : Measure E)
  let cNorm : ℝ≥0∞ := (∫⁻ z, ENNReal.ofReal (w z) ∂ell)⁻¹
  let W : (E × E) × Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ :=
    fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x.1) * ρ y r x.1 n T x.2
  have hU : Continuous U := by
    exact ((hV.continuous.comp continuous_fst).add
      (((continuous_fst.sub continuous_const).norm.pow 2).div_const (2 * η))).add
      ((continuous_snd.norm.pow 2).div_const 2)
  have hw : Measurable (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (w z)) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (Real.continuous_exp.comp hU.neg).measurable
  have hW : Measurable W := (hw.comp measurable_fst).mul hρ
  have hf : Measurable (fun z => cNorm * ENNReal.ofReal (w z)) := measurable_const.mul hw
  have hphase : ell.withDensity (fun z => cNorm * ENNReal.ofReal (w z)) =
      (piY y).prod gamma :=
    (AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPhaseNormalization.actual_phase_gibbs_normalization
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y).2.2.2.2.2.2

steps.title: Rewrite the actual normalized sector measure
steps.text: Use the product-with-density identity, justified by simplex sigma-finiteness. Combine the measurable initial phase density with the actual event density; associativity leaves one constant normalizer multiplying the previous unnormalized weight.
steps.lean:
have hsigma : sigma = (ell.prod (m n T)).withDensity (fun x => cNorm * W x) := by
    change (((piY y).prod gamma).prod (m n T)).withDensity
      (fun x => ρ y r x.1 n T x.2) = _
    rw [← hphase, prod_withDensity_left hf,
      ← withDensity_mul _
        (f := fun x : (E × E) × Prefix n T => cNorm * ENNReal.ofReal (w x.1))
        (g := fun x => ρ y r x.1 n T x.2) (hf.comp measurable_fst) hρliteral]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact mul_assoc _ _ _
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Prove preservation of the full normalized sector
steps.text: Test the pushed-forward measure against every measurable extended-nonnegative F. Rewrite the two density integrals, factor out the constant normalizer and apply the actual unnormalized weighted-sector substitution. Equality of all these integrals proves the full measure identity; no finite integral or cancellation is needed.
steps.formula: \int F\circ\Theta\,d\sigma=Z_y^{-1}\int W(F\circ\Theta)\,d(\ell\otimes m)=Z_y^{-1}\int WF\,d(\ell\otimes m)=\int F\,d\sigma,\quad\Theta_*\sigma=\sigma.
steps.lean:
have hsector : MeasurePreserving Theta sigma sigma := by
    refine ⟨hTheta, ?_⟩
    apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
    intro F hF
    rw [lintegral_map hF hTheta, hsigma]
    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _
        (f := fun x => cNorm * W x) (g := fun x => F (Theta x))
        (measurable_const.mul hW) (hF.comp hTheta),
      lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _
        (f := fun x => cNorm * W x) (g := fun x => F x)
        (measurable_const.mul hW) hF]
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, mul_assoc]
    rw [lintegral_const_mul cNorm (f := fun x => W x * F (Theta x))
        (hW.mul (hF.comp hTheta)),
      lintegral_const_mul cNorm (f := fun x => W x * F x) (hW.mul hF)]
    exact congrArg (fun a => cNorm * a) (h102 y r F hF)
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Push the reversal to endpoint pairs
steps.text: Apply composition of measurable pushforwards and the endpoint intertwining. This transports the full normalized-sector identity through B to precisely the declared endpoint-pair measure L.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨hJ, ?_⟩
  change Measure.map J (Measure.map B sigma) = Measure.map B sigma
  rw [Measure.map_map hJ hB]
  calc
    Measure.map (J ∘ B) sigma = Measure.map (B ∘ Theta) sigma := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact (hinter x).symm
    _ = Measure.map B (Measure.map Theta sigma) := (Measure.map_map hB hTheta).symm
    _ = Measure.map B sigma := by rw [hsector.map_eq]
